means.idiom-jp: (口語で)時間ちょうどに、きっかりに
means.example-sentence: She’d promised me that she’d visit me around two, and she really did so at two on the dot.
means.sentence-jp: 彼女は2時ごろに私を訪問すると約束し、実際に2時ちょうどに訪ねてきた。

cloze.maskedText: She’d promised me that she’d visit me around two, and she really did so at two ____.
